en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground shows fields and scattered farm buildings, while the middle ground is filled with dense clusters of houses, larger spa‑like buildings, and a smokestack, surrounded by trees. In the distance are gently rolling fields, tree‑lined roads, and forested hills. Text printed at the bottom left reads "Radiumbad Oberschlema i. Erzgeb."
